content: X11 XGrabKey is asynchronous: if another client already holds the same key+modifier on the same window the server returns BadAccess via the error handler in the event loop, not as a return value; with AnyModifier/AnyKey the whole request fails and no grabs are established. keybinder-3.0 closes this by wrapping the grab in gdk_error_trap_push/gdk_error_trap_pop plus XSync: on a trapped error it logs 'Failed grab/ungrab!', re-ungrabs the ignorable-modifier variants, and keybinder_bind returns FALSE. So the truth IS available at the C layer; a Flutter/Dart wrapper that discards the gboolean is where 'failed grab reports success' is introduced. Note also XGrabKey grabs leak across restarts if not ungrabbed (autokey #1088).
